description: This file defines the functionality for deleting an article in the application, including request validation and database handling.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property of the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the processing of the delete command, including fetching the article and removing it from the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rule for Slug.

methods.name: Handle(Command message, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
methods.description: Executes the deletion of the article identified by Slug, throwing a NotFound error if not found.
